name: Alien Disc Golf
scanning: Scanning the planet: fetching NOAA's wind
realWind: Today's real wind, from NOAA's forecast
practiceWind: Practice wind: the real wind didn't load

coach.title: Where are we?
coach.say: Name the country the glowing cone is in for a stroke back, or skip the guess.

coach.title: Turn the aim
coach.say: Or the Aim slider, or click the planet. The dashed line is the throw in still air.

coach.title: Set the power
coach.say: Or the Power slider: the km is how far it carries before the wind.

coach.title: Throw
coach.say: L lofts it into the jet stream: longer, and blown far harder.

coach.title: Watch the wind bend it
coach.say: Where it lands is your next throw. Get within {km} km of the basket to hole out.
